Below is Macaroni Kid Asheville's summer camp guide and kids' activity directory, a local guide to kids' programs, as our own crawler read it. Do not search the web. List every organization in it that runs a kids' summer program (day or overnight camp, VBS, clinic, summer program); skip programs that run only during the school year. Take each organization's URL only from the LINKS lines, and only when the link is the organization's own website or registration page; otherwise null. Take the town from its address when one is given.

Summer Camp Guide

AVL Parks and Recreation Theme Camps

Comic Books? Tennis? Creative Art? What is your child's interest? Check out these camps to see if one is a perfect match for your child.

Various spots around town, Asheville, NC Read More

Asheville Community Movement

Gymnastics classes for all ages and levels. After-school care with pick-up from area schools. Fun Night/Parent's Night Out. Toddler Play Time. Bounce House Birthday Parties.

812 Riverside Dr, Asheville, NC Read More

Asheville Community Theatre

Asheville Community Theatre offers Youth Production Classes for K-12 students interested in learning the ins and outs of participating in a big production. Broadway Bootcamp is for middle and high school students who want to sing, dance and act.

35 East Walnut Street, Asheville, NC Read More

Asheville Junior Theater

Whether it’s to improve their talents in preparation for our fall show, or to simply join us for some summer fun, your junior actor is welcome here! Musical theater camps at AJT are great for making friends, developing a stronger sense of self-confidence and strengthening performing chops by exploring choreography, scenes and songs from hit musicals and movies.

174 Bradley Branch Road, Unit 4/5, Arden, NC Read More

Sponsored Asheville Music School

A nonprofit music organization offering private music lessons, student bands and ensembles, scholarships, community outreach, summer camps, adult classes, and more.

10 Ridgelawn Road, Asheville, NC Read More

D-Bat Asheville

*Availability: As of June 1st, a few spots remain in each week offered!

Their half-day summer camps run weekly from June 12th - August 25th and are a great opportunity for baseball and softball athletes (ages 6-13) to learn and develop new skills while having a fun time.

Their instructors will work on fundamentals and advanced techniques adjusting to every skill set. Areas covered will be fielding, hitting, throwing, and base running.

1262 Hendersonville Road, Asheville, NC Read More

Full Moon Equestrian

*Availability update coming soon!

With full day camps running from June 19th - August 11th, horse lovers (ages 6+) are sure to have a summer to remember at Full Moon Equestrian. They will start each day with horse care and barn chores. Later, they'll split into groups for activities such as riding, presentations from local horse experts, horsemanship skills, horse and barn related games and activities along with creative time.

362 Onteora Blvd , Asheville, NC Read More

Summit Crossfit

*Availability: As of June 1st, this summer camp has been cancelled.

With half day camps running from June 26th - July 21st, kids (ages 6-12) are encouraged to develop confidence along with strength of mind and body at Summit Crossfit. They can enjoy an introduction to basic weightlifting, gymnastics, crafts, and games.

21 McArthur Ln, Unit A, Asheville, NC Read More

Swift App School

*Availability: As of June 1st, only a few spots remain! There are also a few FULLY PAID SCHOLARSHIPS remaining. To apply, click here.

Learn to code apps in one week with Swift App School! This summer camp is designed for middle and high school students (ages 13 - 18) and runs June 26-30 from 8 AM to 5 PM at the Hatch Innovation Hub on South French Broad Ave.

Teens will learn to build native apps and games for the iPhone and iPad and develop their own coding super power. No prior coding knowledge required.

45 South French Broad Avenue, Asheville, NC Read More

Sponsored Ultimate Frisbee Summer Camp

Ultimate Frisbee Summer Camp is a camp for rising 2nd graders through High school students. Half and full day camp options are available. Camp caters to novice, intermediate, and advanced players.

34 Pearson Dr., Asheville, NC Read More

Wortham Center for the Performing Arts

The Wortham Center’s ever-popular annual season of national and international touring artists, Wortham Presents, offers live performances of the best in music, dance, theatre, comedy and special attractions.

18 Biltmore Ave., Asheville, NC Read More

Sponsored Zaniac

*Availability: As of June 1st, their summer camps are full; however, you are welcome to call and be placed on their waitlist.

Calling all coders, engineers, scientists, explorers and designers! Discover how the world works and spark your child's curiosity in their Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math Summer Camps. Zaniac offers half-day and full-day camps for kids (ages 5-14) with one-week sessions running from June 12th through August 25th.

They engage your child's mind with interactive summer camps to explore, learn, research, experiment, and innovate. Use their cutting-edge tools to create projects and experiments led by role model instructors.

One Town Square Blvd, Suite 120, Asheville, NC Read More

Black Mountain Center for the Arts

Black Mountain Center for the Arts (BMCA) is a vibrant nonprofit arts hub in downtown Black Mountain, NC. We offer dance, theater, music, visual arts, and ceramics for all ages and skill levels. With classes, performances, workshops, and a rotating gallery, BMCA fosters creativity and community connection. Whether you’re looking to learn, perform, or enjoy the arts, BMCA is the place to be! Visit www.blackmountainarts.org to learn more.

225 West State Street, Black Mountain, NC Read More

Black Mountain Centre for the Arts

The Black Mountain Center for the Arts (BMCA) has been a vibrant hub for creativity and community connection in the Swannanoa Valley since 2000. Offering classes, exhibitions, performances, and events, BMCA celebrates the region's heritage while fostering innovation and inclusivity. Through its diverse programming, the Center enriches lives, strengthens community bonds, and inspires artistic exploration.

225 West State Street, Black Mountain, NC Read More

Mountain Play Lodge

This large indoor playground is great for those summer storm days or when you want to beat the heat. Kids will remember life-sized play sets for 12 and under.

3389 Sweeten Creek Rd., Arden, NC Read More

Visual & Performing Arts Camps

Asheville Community Theatre

Asheville Community Theatre offers Youth Production Classes for K-12 students interested in learning the ins and outs of participating in a big production. Broadway Bootcamp is for middle and high school students who want to sing, dance and act.

35 East Walnut Street, Asheville, NC Read More

Asheville Junior Theater

Whether it’s to improve their talents in preparation for our fall show, or to simply join us for some summer fun, your junior actor is welcome here! Musical theater camps at AJT are great for making friends, developing a stronger sense of self-confidence and strengthening performing chops by exploring choreography, scenes and songs from hit musicals and movies.

174 Bradley Branch Road, Unit 4/5, Arden, NC Read More

Sponsored Asheville Music School

A nonprofit music organization offering private music lessons, student bands and ensembles, scholarships, community outreach, summer camps, adult classes, and more.

10 Ridgelawn Road, Asheville, NC Read More

Wortham Center for the Performing Arts

The Wortham Center’s ever-popular annual season of national and international touring artists, Wortham Presents, offers live performances of the best in music, dance, theatre, comedy and special attractions.

18 Biltmore Ave., Asheville, NC Read More

AVL Parks and Recreation Theme Camps

Various spots around townAsheville, NC 28801
Phone: 828-259-5483Email: parks@ashevillenc.gov

Comic Book Camp Ages 8-12; 285 Livingston Street, Asheville; 828-259-5483
June 12-June 16, 9am-5pm.
Fee: $50, City of Asheville residents receive a $10 discount.
$25 for youth enrolled in Parks and Recreation afterschool programs, Summer Playground Program or Outdoor Camp Program.

Explore the world of comics, cartooning, and creating stories and adventures. Participants will focus on comics as an art form. Youth will learn about story development through creative games and activities, and spend the week developing their own comic adventures. Camp will be at the Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Center

Character Creation Comic Camp Ages 8-12; 285 Livingston Street; 828-259-5483
June 26-June 30, 9am-5pm.
Fee: $50, City of Asheville residents receive a $10 discount.
$25 for youth enrolled in Parks and Recreation afterschool programs, Summer Playground Program or Outdoor Camp Program.
Bring the world of fantasy to life by creating and developing your favorite or very own character. Participants will focus on character development and what it takes to be a superhero. Youth will design unique costumes while learning about different materials used for protection and gadgets. Camp will be at the Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Center.

LEAF For rising 1st-5th graders; 285 Livingston Street;
Week 1: July 24-8, Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm.
Week 2: July 31-Aug 4 Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm.
Fee: $165 for one week or $315 for both weeks if scheduled at the same time. Scholarships available.
Is your child a creative star in the making? Youth will enjoy recreational and cultural arts activities, and work with instructors specializing in a variety of performing arts genres. At the end of the camp, each young artist will showcase their talents during a final performance. Weeks are structured as separate camps and will be held at the Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside.

Tennis Camp Ages 8-14; 336 Hillard Ave; 828-251-4074
Beginner/Intermediate: Week 1: June 12-15; Week 2: June 19-22
Intermediate/Advanced: Week 3: June 26-29
Fee: $125/week, City of Asheville residents receive a $25 discount.
Focuses on progressive skill development and play. All camps are conducted by a certified tennis professional of the United States Professional Tennis Registry (USPTR). The camp will be held at Aston Park Tennis Center in downtown Asheville.

Eco Explorers Camp 6-8 year olds; 749 Fairview Road; 828-251-4080
Session 1: June 19-21
Session 2: June 26-28
NEW CAMP HOURS: 9am-5pm.
Fee: $120. City of Asheville residents receive a $10 discount. Fee includes all equipment, instruction, and transportation.
A three day camp focused on exploration and fun outdoors! Activities include hiking, stream investigation, animal visits, climbing wall and a field trip to Grandfather Mountain. Campers must bring lunch and water daily. 12 campers maximum per session.

Adventure Camp 8-12 year olds; 749 Fairview Road; 828-251-4080
Session 1: June 12-16
Session 2: July 17-21
Fee: $220. City of Asheville residents receive a $10 discount. Fee includes all equipment, instruction, meals while camping, and transportation.
This 5 day camp includes hiking, swimming, rafting, tubing, games, environmental education and camping. Camp runs 9am-5pm Monday-Wednesday with an overnight campout Thursday night. Pick up will be noon on Friday. Campers must bring lunch & water each day, and provide their own sleeping bag/pad for the campout. Camps will form into two groups for age based activities - ages 8-10 and 10-12. For 10 year olds, please indicate preferred age group. 24 campers maximum per session.

Summer Close Out Camp For rising 1st to 5th graders; Multiple Sites; 828-259-5773
August 21, 22, 23, 8:30am-6pm.
Fee: $30 for first child, $20 for siblings.
Close out the summer with us! The fun will include games, crafts, cultural arts

Asheville Community Movement

812 Riverside DrAsheville, NC
Phone: 8282546060Email: office@ashevillecommunitymovement.comWebsite: Visit Website

A family owned and operated business dedicated to providing a fun, enriching, and nurturing environment for children and teens. All classes are taught by well trained coaches who focus on correct technique and skill progression while nurturing the students' need to have fun and build confidence. The wish is to create an ideal atmosphere for athletes to challenge themselves and a comfortable setting for children to stay while their parents work.

Fall club choices include Gymnastics, Tennis, Basketball, Dance, Archery, Yarn & Fabric, Drawing & Painting, Drama and Music. Ten week Session Pricing: M-F $650; M/W/F $455; T-Th $305
